description_en: Retrieves Hive table analysis results in batches by using EMR Doctor
description_zh: 通过EMR Doctor批量获取Hive表分析结果
name: ListDoctorHiveTables

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that specifies the starting position for the next query
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置

parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The sort criterion. Valid values:

partitionNum: the number of partitions.
totalFileCount: the total number of files.
largeFileCount: the number of large files. A large file is larger than 1 GB in size.
mediumFileCount: the number of medium files. A medium file is 128 MB to 1 GB in size.
smallFileCount: the number of small files. A small file is 10 MB to 128 MB in size.
tinyFileCount: the number of tiny files. A tiny file is larger than 0 MB and smaller than 10 MB in size.
emptyFileCount: the number of empty files. An empty file is 0 MB in size.
largeFileRatio: the proportion of large files. A large file is larger than 1 GB in size.
mediumFileRatio: the proportion of medium files. A medium file is 128 MB to 1 GB in size.
smallFileRatio: the proportion of small files. A small file is 10 MB to 128 MB in size.
tinyFileRatio: the proportion of tiny files. A tiny file is larger than 0 MB and smaller than 10 MB in size.
emptyFileRatio: the proportion of empty files. An empty file is 0 MB in size.
hotDataSize: the size of hot data. Hot data refers to data accessed within the last 7 days.
warmDataSize: the size of warm data. Warm data refers to data not accessed within the last 7 days but accessed within the last 30 days.
coldDataSize: the size of cold data. Cold data refers to data not accessed within the last 30 days but accessed within the last 90 days.
freezeDataSize: the size of frozen data. Frozen data refers to data not accessed within the last 90 days.
totalDataSize: the total data size.
hotDataRatio: the proportion of hot data. Hot data refers to data accessed within the last 7 days.
warmDataRatio: the proportion of warm data. Warm data refers to data not accessed within the last 7 days but accessed within the last 30 days.
coldDataRatio: the proportion of cold data. Cold data refers to data not accessed within the last 30 days but accessed within the last 90 days.
freezeDataRatio: the proportion of frozen data. Frozen data refers to data not accessed within the last 90 days.
totalFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the total number of files.
largeFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the number of large files. A large file is larger than 1 GB in size.
mediumFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the number of medium files. A medium file is 128 MB to 1 GB in size.
smallFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the number of small files. A small file is 10 MB to 128 MB in size.
tinyFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the number of tiny files. A tiny file is larger than 0 MB and smaller than 10 MB in size.
emptyFileDayGrowthCount: the daily increment of the number of empty files. An empty file is 0 MB in size.
hotDataDayGrowthSize: the daily increment of the hot data size. Hot data refers to data accessed within the last 7 days.
warmDataDayGrowthSize: the daily increment of the warm data size. Warm data refers to data not accessed within the last 7 days but accessed within the last 30 days.
coldDataDayGrowthSize: the daily increment of the cold data size. Cold data refers to data not accessed within the last 30 days but accessed within the last 90 days.
freezeDataDayGrowthSize: the daily increment of the frozen data size. Frozen data refers to data not accessed within the last 90 days.
totalDataDayGrowthSize: the daily increment of the total data size.
totalFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the total number of files.
largeFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the number of large files. A large file is larger than 1 GB in size.
mediumFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the number of medium files. A medium file is 128 MB to 1 GB in size.
smallFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the number of small files. A small file is 10 MB to 128 MB in size.
tinyFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the number of tiny files. A tiny file is larger than 0 MB and smaller than 10 MB in size.
emptyFileCountDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the number of empty files. An empty file is 0 MB in size.
hotDataSizeDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the hot data size. Hot data refers to data accessed within the last 7 days.
warmDataSizeDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the warm data size. Warm data refers to data not accessed within the last 7 days but accessed within the last 30 days.
coldDataSizeDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the cold data size. Cold data refers to data not accessed within the last 30 days but accessed within the last 90 days.
freezeDataSizeDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the frozen data size. Frozen data refers to data not accessed within the last 90 days.
totalDataSizeDayGrowthRatio: the day-over-day growth rate of the total data size
